I made these resources mainly in Indonesian to increase accessibility for Indonesians wanting to learn about infectious disease modelling. I tried my best to attribute sources within each material.

For HTML materials, please right-click then Save Link As (untuk materi bertipe HTML, klik kanan pada link lalu Save Link As).

1. [Introduction to programming with R (Pengantar pemrograman dengan R)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andradjaafara/intro_to_R/main/intro_to_R_bimandra_djaafara.html)

2. [SIR model with odin in R (Pemodelan penyakit infeksi SIR dengan package odin di R)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andradjaafara/intro_sir_model_R/main/intro_sir_model_R.html)
